context:
Goal: joyous merges with no required check, as the other private repos do, after your 11:20 CST Nov 16 order that private repos run no CI.
Why you: only the repository admin can change a ruleset, in the GitHub UI. The consultant (15:59 CST, relayed by the coordinator; I did not read the ruleset) says joyous's ruleset still requires a check and no session can remove it.
Hold: runner 12 says (15:52 CST, relayed, not read by me) that joyous's ruleset 24853807 was already set to enforcement disabled by REST at 15:50 CST. If its read holds, this task is moot; I am asking it for the read and will close this item or confirm it. Do not act until then.
Steps: open https://github.com/shivinate7/joyous/settings/rules, open the ruleset that requires a status check on main, remove the required check, save, then press Done. This pairs with item 929, option d (you merge the five setup PRs by hand).
home: decision private-repos-no-ci (PR #3590, merged 15:43 CST Nov 16); item 929 (the five setup PRs)
reply: Closed as moot, 16:02 CST. Runner 12's REST read at 16:01 CST (relayed, not read by me): joyous's only ruleset, id 24853807, has enforcement "disabled", updated 12:50 CST. Its rules (deletion, non_fast_forward, pull_request, required_status_checks all-jobs-passed) do not apply while it is disabled, so no required check blocks a merge now. If anyone re-enables it, all-jobs-passed is required again and blocks merges; who disabled it is unknown. Classic protection on main reads required_status_checks null and enforce_admins true (the joyous builder, 15:50 CST, not re-read). Nothing is asked of you.
short: Remove joyous's required check in its ruleset
title: Remove the required status check from joyous's main ruleset in the GitHub settings page
why: The consultant's word, 15:59 CST: joyous's ruleset still requires a check. Unmeasured by me.
